headline.text: L3 truffle line ran production through a scheduled clean — wire mesh belt monitored and repaired by outside techs, no downtime.

per_plant_summary.L1: No production activity in the last 24 hours. Waiting on overdue brown sugar delivery and kraft box shipment, both expected Monday.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line ran 14-gram Bite Dark SS through the shift with all quality checks passing. Overnight crew completed level 2 weekend clean and ATP validation. Wire mesh belt monitored throughout shift, repaired by outside techs during clean window.

notes.text: Brown sugar truck overdue from last week — 85,000 lbs expected Monday, pending supplier confirmation.
ML4 belts laser-marked to prevent size mismatches after recurring incorrect installations.

resolved.title: Enrober wire mesh belt gap monitored and repaired
resolved.summary: Belt held stable through production shift, outside techs arrived early and completed repair during scheduled clean window.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:13 — "Enrober wire mesh fixed" (Raoul Lubain). Belt ran with maintenance for 15 minutes post-repair.

resolved.title: Truffle line level 2 weekend clean
resolved.summary: Full teardown clean of depositor, tunnels, enrober, packaging equipment completed and ATP-validated.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:22 — "Level 2 clean completed and passed off ATP" (Raoul Lubain). All equipment cleaned, inspected, and run-tested.
